# `⍕` — Format

Keys: `Alt-n t`. Ranks: `∞` monadic, `1 ∞` dyadic

`⍕Y` returns character text. Matrix rows remain rows.

```bpl
⍕1 2 3             ⍝ "1 2 3"
```

`D⍕Y` gives `D` decimal places. A negative `D` gives exponent notation with `|D|` significant digits.

```bpl
2⍕3.125            ⍝ " 3.13"
¯2⍕1234.5          ⍝ " 1.2ₑ3"
```

`W D⍕Y` also sets the field width `W`. Give one pair per column to set each column separately. Width 0 chooses a width. Overflowing fields become `*`.

```bpl
6 2⍕3.125          ⍝ "  3.13"
```

Formatting is independent of REPL boxing.

## Inverse

Neither form has an inverse.
